budget.interpretation: The batched-DLEQ fixed-linear compiler can retain at most this many scalar bases under one MiB. A real LVA gadget compiler may use a different mix of G1/G2 elements and must be measured separately.
budget.kill_rule: Reject the fixed-relation route if relation-specific CRS/key material, excluding a genuinely universal reusable CRS, exceeds the remaining byte budget.

width_328.security_boundary: The batch proof is a Fiat-Shamir random-linear-combination check. It is not a replacement for malicious distributed setup.
